M-PATHS.NAME: Ids and path safety
M-PATHS.purpose: Validate entity ids and resolve entity/config paths without allowing traversal (ADR-4).

fn-assertEntityId.PURPOSE: Validate and return an id, or throw UsageError.

fn-entityDir.PURPOSE: docs/modules, docs/plans or docs/verification under a root.

fn-entityPath.PURPOSE: Validated path of an entity file.

fn-assertSafeRelativePath.PURPOSE: Reject absolute paths, .. segments, NUL and drive prefixes.

fn-resolveWithin.PURPOSE: Resolve a candidate and prove it stays inside a base directory.

fn-docsRelative.PURPOSE: docs/<segments> relative path helper for messages.

contract.purpose: Validate entity ids and resolve entity/config paths without allowing traversal (ADR-4).

param.name: id
param.description: Untrusted id from CLI args, XML attributes or MCP calls.

param.name: entityPath
param.description: Absolute path proven to be inside docs/<entity-dir>.

error.description: Empty, absolute, leading-dash, malformed or traversal id/path.

notes.note-1: Ids reaching the filesystem or a shell are untrusted input in a cloned repository.
notes.note-2: The grammar is intentionally narrow: letters, digits, underscores and dashes only.
notes.note-3: Path containment is proven after normalization, not by string prefix comparison.
